title: Entity growth batch 03 — group E
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #199. Canonical publication prohibited until candidate validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Hardware-wallet ecosystem from SecuX covering touchscreen cold wallets and companion wallet software.
entities.notes: Current first-party SecuX product material establishes an active hardware-wallet family and states seed phrases/private keys are generated and stored offline. Initial wallet launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Self-custody cold-storage wallet ecosystem from CompoSecure built around an NFC secure-element card and mobile application.
entities.notes: Arculus first-party history explicitly states the Arculus brand and Cold Storage Wallet launched in 2021.

entities.summary: Self-custody hardware-wallet ecosystem centered on Cypherock X1, which distributes wallet key material across an X1 Vault and four X1 Cards.
entities.notes: Current first-party Cypherock documentation describes the X1 as a self-custody hardware wallet whose key shards are held across user-controlled hardware components. Initial product/company launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Open-source DIY Bitcoin signing-device project for building air-gapped, stateless hardware signers from off-the-shelf components.
entities.notes: SeedSigner is a DIY/open-source signing project, not an ordinary hardware vendor. First-party documentation explicitly says users build their own device and that there are no official or approved SeedSigner vendors.

entities.summary: Open-source non-custodial mobile Web3 wallet for Polkadot, Kusama and supported networks.
entities.notes: Current first-party Nova documentation explicitly describes Nova Wallet as non-custodial on iOS and Android with private keys stored locally on the user's device. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: SecuX V20 touchscreen hardware wallet with secure-element protection and offline private-key generation/storage.
products.notes: Current official shop lists V20 with price and purchase controls, supporting on_sale. Initial product launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Arculus self-custody cold-storage wallet combining an NFC secure-element card with the Arculus mobile app and three-factor authentication.
products.notes: Arculus first-party history states the Cold Storage Wallet launched in 2021. Current official product page lists stock, price and Buy Now controls, supporting on_sale.

products.summary: Cypherock X1 hardware wallet that distributes wallet key material across an X1 Vault and four user-controlled X1 Cards.
products.notes: Current official store provides Add to cart / Buy Now controls, supporting on_sale. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

platform: Raspberry Pi Zero and compatible DIY hardware
products.summary: DIY air-gapped stateless Bitcoin signing device built from publicly available components and SeedSigner open-source software.
products.notes: Sales status is not_applicable because SeedSigner does not define an official retail hardware product; first-party hardware guidance explicitly says there are no official or approved vendors.

products.summary: Nova Wallet non-custodial mobile application for Polkadot, Kusama and supported Web3 networks on iOS and Android.
products.notes: Current first-party documentation explicitly establishes iOS/Android distribution and local private-key storage. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.
